pw_r1.line: It was misfiled to me on the grounds that I can read. A person at the Arcade has applied to a literary society. Twenty-four applications, twenty-four refusals, and it's now within the by-laws for me to consider joining as the treasurer, purely in order to see the file. I'm not going to. I'm only saying it's permitted.

pw_r2.line: Somebody ought to tell them their refusal letter has a mistake in it. I don't mean it should be accepted. I mean there's a comma.

pw_c1s.line: I can give you that in writing. I can also, if you require, certify that I gave it to you in writing, though I'd need you to sign for the first one.

pw_c2.line: I was asked to certify the copy. I haven't said the collection is.

pw_c3.line: Then we ought to read the same line. Here. "Together with the reversion of the adjoining parcel." Adjoining which, you'll say, and it gives the lot and block, and I would prefer you read those aloud, so that it's you who said them.

pw_c4.line: It's what the paper says. It is the first of August. I filed it. Nobody asked me to read it for anything. I read it.

pw_rc1.line: That's a rent receipt in the Estate's name, dated after the term. Strictly, that shows the Estate collected. Whether it was entitled to is a question for a court, and whether a court would ask depends on who petitions, and the petitioner would want counsel who'd read... you've read it.

choices.label: Would you put your name to that?

pw_rc2.line: I'd need... The firm would never... Yes.

pw_st1.line: I was. A search is a quarter and the fare, and I have the stub, because I keep them. "Last searched 14 June. A lady, no name given."

choices.label: The Record had her in gloves, the morning after the tea.

pw_st1s.line: I can certify that it is a stub. I wouldn't go further than the stub.

pw_st2.line: I can't say who. I can say she read the schedule and only the schedule, which is the one part nobody reads. I read it. It took me six weeks to say so.

pw_m1.line: It was correct. There was a comma. I took it back to see to the comma.

pw_m2.line: That the term ends on the first of August, and a tenant might wish to take counsel first. For Miss Quell's boards. It was out of my hands for twenty-five minutes. Mrs. Marsh has the seven drafts, if you prefer them from someone who marked them.

choices.label: And after you fixed the comma?

pw_m3.line: It is on my desk. The comma is in. It is correct now. I have been meaning to send it.

pw_q1.line: I would like to know who to write to. Not to complain. It would be irregular to complain, I wasn't asked anything. I only feel that a person who has been removed from a sentence ought to be sent a form. I looked. I am fairly sure there is no form. I'd sign it if there were.

pw_so1.line: We file their notices. That is, the firm does, I wouldn't say I do. One word, each November, paid in advance. I asked what it is they prevent. I was told I should be glad it hadn't happened. I can't say that's an answer. I can't say it isn't.
